answer: A farm running 186 keys therefore pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation inexpensive. Because the nebula stake is held until the basalt settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the wander audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 42% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
